# DSH Theme
**English** | 简体中文

Theme palettes, a full DIY color editor, fonts, and interface text size for the
DeepSeek Harness Web

GUI —
switchable from a palette icon at the bottom-left of the sidebar.

Dark and light are first class: every preset and every DIY color carries a value
for both modes, so

it keeps working when the native appearance switches between
light, dark, and system.
## Screenshots

| Chinese UI | English UI |
|:---:|:---:|

**Entry point: the palette icon at the bottom-left of the sidebar** — the action
row of icons direct

ly above the Settings button. Click it to open the panel; the
same options are also available under
**Settings → 个性化 / Personalization**.
The interface copy follows the app language (Simplified Chinese / English).
## Features

- **Bottom-left trigger** — a palette icon in the sidebar foot (row above
Settings). One click opens

a compact popover anchored bottom-left.
- **Settings page** — the same content is also a dedicated

**个性化 / Personalization** page in Settings.
- **10 presets** — Default (stock harness), Warm, Mono,

Claude, Claude+, Vermillion,
Amber Mono, MX Brutalist, Tiesen, Vescrow, plus a **Custom** card.
- **

DIY theme editor** — per light/dark mode: background, card, popover, sidebar,
text, border, and that

mode's accent color; shared error/success/warning colors;
and a **Bold borders** switch (1 px borde

rs everywhere + ink-strength border
tokens). Unpinned slots derive from the background/text automati

cally.
- **Fonts** — independent Latin and Chinese stacks plus a code font, applied to
interface, co

nversation, and code text.
- **Text size** — 10–22 px through the native theme service, so it surviv

es
reloads and shares the Ctrl/Cmd `+`/`-` shortcuts.
- **Bilingual UI** — follows the app language

(Simplified Chinese / English).
- **Restart-safe persistence** — choices are stored in DSH's Host se

ttings
document, so they survive app restarts and profile changes of the localhost
port. No `localSt

so they survive app restarts and profile changes of the localhost
port. No `localStorage` surprises.

### Discover — recommended
No npm account and no manual profile wiring:

1. Open **Plugins → Discover**.
2. Add this index source:

The index is version-pinned so it is available immediately. Replace the tag with
`@main` for the mov
ing branch — jsDelivr may cache it for up to 12 hours.
3. Find **DSH Theme**, open its page, and press **Install**.

Discover installs the pinned Git commit of the release. The same release is also
published to npm as

`@solvashq/dsh-theme@1.4.0`, and a prebuilt `dsh-theme.tgz`
is attached to the latest GitHub Releas

e. jsDelivr may cache the `@main` branch
for up to 12 hours; purge
`https://purge.jsdelivr.net/gh/So

lvasHQ/dsh-theme@main/market/index.json` to pick
up a new release immediately.
### npm
The bundle is published as `@solvashq/dsh-theme`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or let your DSH agent install the bundle from npm with the spec
`@solvashq/dsh-theme@1.4.0`.
### From source (development)

> This is a **local DSH bundle**. It is installed by linking the cloned directory
> into a DSH profi

le and adding it to that profile's bundle list. Node.js 20+ and
> pnpm are required.
1. Clone the repository somewhere stable:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

2. Install the plugin's runtime dependencies **inside the plugin directory**.
DSH loads profile plug

ins with symlink-preserving resolution, so the schema
library and its transitive packages must live

in the plugin's own
`node_modules`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Register the bundle in your DSH profile. The recommended way is to ask your
DSH agent to install

the bundle from this directory (Plugin Manager's bundle
installation with the absolute path). Manual

wiring is also possible — in
`<profile>/package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
then run `pnpm install` inside the profile directory and restart DSH.

4. Open the Web GUI: the palette icon appears at the bottom-left of the sidebar,
and **Settings → 个性
化 / Personalization** shows the same page.

After that, client-side changes to `client.js` are hot-swapped by DSH's client
HMR transport within
about a second; Host-side changes need a DSH restart.
## How it works

- **Theme layer** — the client half registers a single
`ctx.theme.overrideTokens('@solvashq/dsh-them

e', tokens)` layer. Every
token is a `{ light, dark }` pair, so the layer composes over whichever
bu

ilt-in palette is active and survives OS scheme flips without touching the
theme registry.
- **Token

generation** — 14 anchor colors per palette/mode are expanded into the
~97 `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw

-specific-*` semantic tokens (surfaces, borders,
labels, buttons, states, markdown/code, diff views,

scrollbars, toasts,
sidebar) with contrast guards.
- **DIY palettes** — derived at runtime from the

picked backgrounds, borders,
text colors, and per-mode accents, so a background change keeps a mode

coherent until the user pins a specific slot.
- **Fonts** — `--dsh-font-family-text` / `--dsh-font-

family-code` ride in the
same token layer. The Latin and Chinese stacks are composed together; the
u

nselected side falls back to the harness's built-in stack.
- **Text size** — uses the theme service'

s own persisted `setFontSize('text', px)`.
- **Persistence** — the host half declares one `.volatile

()` string field on the
plugin entry; the client reads/writes it through `ctx.configForms`. DSH
pers

ists that value in the active profile's patch, keyed by the authenticated
browser identity. Light/da

rk preference and text size stay with the native
theme settings.
## Compatibility

Tested against DeepSeek Harness desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (Web GUI). The plugin uses
the documented clien

t seams (`slots`, `theme`, `locale`, `configForms`) and
host-side volatile config; it does not patch

the harness or read other plugins'
DOM.
